title: A wonderful place to visit when in Barcelona
text: Park Güell is a wonderful family experience with lots of interesting spaces to explore. Very pretty with many “engineering marvels” thanks to the designer and architect, Anto ió Gaudi. You can take a separate tour of his museum, as well.
author: LouiseASL

title: Never too old to learn something new!
text: Enjoyed learning about the man and his mission. Great tour guide, very knowledgeable and friendly. Got some wonderful pictures and can’t wait to return to Barcelona some day.
author: bernadettew249

title: A must visit in Barcelona
text:
This park is huge park and you can spend 3 hours easily walking through the whole park.  You need to be prepared to walk up stairs and inclines.   I booked tickets through TripAdvisor for just the entry the same day after the original booking I had with a tour guide was cancelled the day of the tour.  I had an issue with getting the tickets for your group.  If buying just entry tickets I recommend buying at the park and not through TripAdvisor or Viator.  They have QR codes at entrance to buy your tickets,

title: Enjoyable!
text: Great experience our guide was very knowledgeable and answered questions. Gave directions on how to explore the park.
author: Rhonda U

title: Magical
text: What a magical and beautiful place!  Gaudi was beyond creative!  The grounds were gorgeous and only issue was the day we toured was about 92 degrees!!!  Can't change the weather, but it made for a draining day in the heat.
author: KathyM33

title: Nice visit and very pleasant guide
text: The woman who gave us the tour was knowledgeable about the park and a lot of related stories around it. It was well organized too.
author: benster21

title: Very impressed.
text: Park Guell make it so difficult to buy tickets. So we were very happy when the Luxury Travel rep came to the rescue. Easy to buy tickets, cheaper than the park advertised ones, and they included an excellent short tour. Very impressed.
